name: Raw Talk
description: In the aftermath of Monday Night Raw, catch up with your favorite Superstars to hear their thoughts and opinions on all of the evening's action. These men and women hold nothing back as they engage in Raw Talk.

videos.title: June 1, 2020
videos.overview: Nothing is off limits as your favorite Raw Superstars join hosts Charly Caruso and Samoa Joe on the premiere of Raw Talk. Seth Rollins explains his vision for the greater good of Raw. The Street Profits and The Viking Raiders discuss what should be the next competition in their series.

videos.title: January 4, 2021
videos.overview: Charlotte Flair explains her frustrations with her father Ric Flair. Mustafa Ali tears into Raw's Legends Night. Shayna Baszler sends a clear message to the WWE Universe.

videos.title: January 11, 2021
videos.overview: Angel Garza offers his rose to guest host Sarah Schreiber. Nia Jax talks about her seemingly rocky tag team partnership with Shayna Baszler. MVP loses his cool and explodes on R-Truth.

videos.title: January 18, 2021
videos.overview: The Miz and John Morrison share their reactions to “The Dirt Sheet” with Gillberg and phony "Drew McIntyre" on Raw. Shayna Baszler speaks about her convenient alliance with Nia Jax. AJ Styles and Omos discuss the 2021 Royal Rumble Match and The Phenomenal One's new WWE Network documentary about his 2016 Royal Rumble debut.

videos.title: January 25, 2021
videos.overview: Charlotte Flair speaks about her father's relationship with Lacey Evans. Elias and Jaxson Ryker agree on their favorite barbeque and who is going to win the Royal Rumble Match. Bobby Lashley tries to play peacekeeper as tensions rise between MVP and the Raw Talk hosts.

videos.title: February 1, 2021
videos.overview: Lacey Evans and WWE Hall of Famer Ric Flair explain their relationship and put the women’s locker room on notice. Naomi & Lana celebrate their WWE Women's Tag Team Title opportunity. Xavier Woods calls out RETRIBUTION's RECKONING. Kofi Kingston talks about his rivalry with Mustafa Ali.

videos.title: February 8, 2021
videos.overview: 2021 Royal Rumble winner Bianca Belair talks about who she could challenge at WrestleMania. Damian Priest discusses his friendship with Bad Bunny. Mustafa Ali continues to deliver vitriol toward WWE, The New Day and even Raw Talk.

videos.title: February 15, 2021
videos.overview: MVP takes responsibility for The Hurt Business' loss on Raw. Nia Jax and Shayna Baszler walk off after Charly Caruso and R-Truth tell one too many jokes at Nia's expense. Sheamus is full of confidence heading into the Elimination Chamber.

videos.title: February 22, 2021
videos.overview: United States Champion Riddle gives his new championship a name. Naomi & Lana are all smiles after their victory on Raw. AJ Styles trash talks former WWE Champion Drew McIntyre.

videos.title: March 1, 2021
videos.overview: WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Shayna Baszler & Nia Jax are not fans of Raw Talk's fill-in host Kayla Braxton. Elias & Jaxson Ryker talk about Bad Bunny. Drew McIntyre gives advice to new WWE Champion Bobby Lashley.

videos.title: March 8, 2021
videos.overview: R-Truth welcomes new Raw Talk host Kevin Patrick to the show. The New Day turn the tables on "KP" and interview him. Peyton Royce demands a chance to challenge Asuka for the Raw Women's Championship. Riddle can't wait for his United States Title defense against Mustafa Ali.

videos.title: March 15, 2021
videos.overview: R-Truth argues with The Miz & John Morrison over how the Raw Talk host became 24-7 Champion on Raw. Mandy Rose & Dana Brooke have their eyes on the WWE Women's Tag Team Championship. Drew McIntyre is ready to battle Sheamus at WWE Fastlane.

videos.title: March 22, 2021
videos.overview: Sheamus is fed up with the disrespect. Rhea Ripley discusses her Raw debut and huge WrestleMania showdown. Braun Strowman shows his rage as he talks about Shane McMahon.

videos.title: March 29, 2021
videos.overview: United States Champion Riddle addresses his rivalry with Sheamus. Raw Women's Champion Asuka reacts to her contract signing with Rhea Ripley. The Miz & John Morrison discuss their latest single, “Hey Hey, Hop Hop.”

videos.title: April 5, 2021
videos.overview: Braun Strowman, WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Nia Jax & Shayna Baszler, and Drew McIntyre share their final thoughts before WrestleMania.

videos.title: April 12, 2021
videos.overview: Xavier Woods co-hosts and discusses the feeling of having fans at WrestleMania. Sheamus recaps winning the United States Title at The Show of Shows. The Viking Raiders talk about their return on Raw. New Raw Women's Champion Rhea Ripley speaks about being attacked by Charlotte Flair.

videos.title: April 19, 2021
videos.overview: WWE Official Adam Pearce delivers breaking news in response to Charlotte Flair physically abusing a referee. MVP comments on MACE & T-BAR's attacks on Drew McIntyre. Naomi & Lana feel they deserve a WWE Women's Tag Team Title opportunity. Damian Priest talks about his confrontation with The Miz.

videos.title: April 26, 2021
videos.overview: Riddle talks about his new partnership with Randy Orton. Sonya Deville explains why she lifted Charlotte Flair's suspension. WWE Champion Bobby Lashley and MVP react to Braun Strowman's addition to WrestleMania Backlash's WWE Title Match.

videos.title: May 3, 2021
videos.overview: Raw Women's Champion Rhea Ripley discusses her upcoming Triple Threat Match at WrestleMania Backlash. Damian Priest looks ahead to his new episode of WWE Chronicle. Drew McIntyre talks about his new book.

videos.title: May 10, 2021
videos.overview: Kevin Patrick asks R-Truth a big question. Braun Strowman reacts to his destructive performance on Raw. Jinder Mahal discusses his return and his new cohorts Veer and Shanky. Charlotte Flair talks about her opponents at WrestleMania Backlash.

videos.title: May 17, 2021
videos.overview: Kevin Patrick apologizes to R-Truth. WWE Women's Tag Team Champion Natalya & Tamina reflect on their emotional journey to the titles and bizarre appearance on Alexa's Playground. The new Angel Garza is ready to share his roses. Kofi Kingston & Xavier Woods celebrate New Day style.

videos.title: May 24, 2021
videos.overview: Charlotte Flair discusses her newly-announced match at WWE Hell in a Cell. Ricochet explains why he targeted Sheamus on Raw. Riddle reacts to his battle against Xavier Woods.

videos.title: May 31, 2021
videos.overview: Raw Tag Team Champions AJ Styles & Omos discuss potential challengers. Nikki Cross reflects on her Beat the Clock Challenge Match victories over Rhea Ripley and Charlotte Flair. Drew McIntyre praises Kofi Kingston.
